metadata.title: Complete Unified Astrological Systems Framework with Expanded Integration
sources_integrated: The Art of Chart Interpretation by Tracy Marks
Comprehensive Astrological Rulership Systems - Traditional vs. Modern
metadata.description: A complete synthesis of multiple astrological traditions including psychological, traditional, modern, esoteric, and technical approaches with expanded keyword systems

unified_principles.cosmic_sympathy: The celestial pattern is resonant, not causative—a higher-dimensional signature manifesting through all scales
unified_principles.anima_mundi_participation: Planets as concentrations of archetypal consciousness with which one can engage dialogically
unified_principles.telesmatic_imagination: Astrological symbols as gateways to direct experiential knowing through visualization and embodiment
unified_principles.energy_language: Astrology as a language of energy focusing on inner experience and psychological dynamics
unified_principles.quality_over_quantity: Focus on most outstanding chart features rather than covering everything
unified_principles.empowerment_focus: Charts are not static; we can direct planetary energies through self-awareness and effort

geocentric.purpose: Earth-centered perspective; shows personal experience and manifestation

heliocentric.purpose: Sun-centered perspective; shows soul's purpose and cosmic alignment

draconic.purpose: Node-centered perspective; shows karmic blueprint and soul's journey

arroyo_approach.core: Focus on essentials - ignore minor factors that confuse rather than clarify
principles: Astrology is a language of energy - learn to speak it fluently
Prioritize inner experience - charts show psychological dynamics more than events
Use guidelines, not rules - adapt to each unique person
Think wholistically - synthesis is more valuable than analysis

magi_approach.core: Precision-based system combining geocentric and heliocentric charts
principles: Super aspects (geocentric-heliocentric aspects) are particularly powerful
Chiron as central planet of marriage and relationships
Planetary pairs indicate specific life areas (Venus-Jupiter = money & love)

traditional_approach.purpose: Astrology as a sacred language of divination, a way to understand the Divine Mind
traditional_approach.cosmology: Geocentric model with Earth as center of divine observation
traditional_approach.hermetic_influence: Rooted in Hermetic principles of 'as above, so below'
traditional_approach.divine_order: Astrology represents humanity's attempt to understand the Will of God or Divine Plan

modern_approach.evolution: Adaptation to scientific discoveries (heliocentrism, outer planets)
modern_approach.psychology_integration: Incorporation of Jungian and depth psychology concepts
modern_approach.secularization: Shift from divine/sacred to psychological/character analysis
modern_approach.personal_growth_emphasis: Focus on self-development rather than fate/destiny

tracy_marks_approach.interpretation_philosophy: Focus on most outstanding chart features rather than covering everything; quality over quantity
tracy_marks_approach.key_principle: Start with characteristics that are most extreme, powerful, and outstanding
tracy_marks_approach.empowerment_message: Charts are not static; we can direct planetary energies through self-awareness and effort

general_formula.description: Core calculation method for all Arabic Parts
steps: Identify two significators (planets, house cusps, or special degrees)
Calculate arc: Arc = Longitude(Significator B) - Longitude(Significator A)
If Longitude(B) < Longitude(A), add 360° to Longitude(B) first
Add arc to projection point (usually Ascendant): Sum = Arc + Longitude(Projection Point)
Project sum from 0° of projection sign: Part Location = Projection Sign (0°) + Sum

parts_list.name: Pars Fortunae (Part of Fortune)
parts_list.diurnal_formula: Measure from Sun to Moon; project from Ascendant
parts_list.nocturnal_formula: Measure from Moon to Sun; project from Ascendant

parts_list.name: Pars Futurorum (Part of Future/Sun)
parts_list.diurnal_formula: Measure from Moon to Sun; project from Ascendant
parts_list.nocturnal_formula: Measure from Sun to Moon; project from Ascendant

parts_list.name: Pars Saturni (Part of Saturn)
parts_list.diurnal_formula: Measure from Saturn to Pars Fortunae; project from Ascendant
parts_list.nocturnal_formula: Measure from Pars Fortunae to Saturn; project from Ascendant

parts_list.name: Pars Vitae (Part of Life)
parts_list.diurnal_formula: Measure from Jupiter to Saturn; project from Ascendant
parts_list.nocturnal_formula: Measure from Saturn to Jupiter; project from Ascendant

parts_list.name: Pars Patris (Part of Father)
parts_list.diurnal_formula: Measure from Sun to Saturn; project from Ascendant
parts_list.nocturnal_formula: Measure from Saturn to Sun; project from Ascendant
parts_list.special_note: If Saturn is combust (under Sun's beams), use Jupiter instead of Saturn

parts_list.name: Pars Matrum (Part of Mother)
parts_list.diurnal_formula: Measure from Venus to Moon; project from Ascendant
parts_list.nocturnal_formula: Measure from Moon to Venus; project from Ascendant

parts_list.name: Pars Coniugii (Part of Marriage, Men)
parts_list.diurnal_formula: Measure from Saturn to Venus; project from Ascendant
parts_list.nocturnal_formula: Measure from Saturn to Venus; project from Ascendant

parts_list.name: Pars Mortis (Part of Death)
parts_list.formula: Measure from Moon to 8th house cusp, add Saturn's completed degrees in its sign, project from beginning of Saturn's sign
parts_list.special_note: Does not use Ascendant as projection point

parts_list.name: Pars Regni (Part of Kingship)
parts_list.diurnal_formula: Measure from Mars to Moon; project from Ascendant
parts_list.nocturnal_formula: Measure from Moon to Mars; project from Ascendant

parts_list.name: Pars Frumentum (Part of Grain)
parts_list.diurnal_formula: Measure from Sun to Mars; project from Ascendant
parts_list.nocturnal_formula: Measure from Sun to Mars; project from Ascendant
parts_list.special_note: Model formula for other commodity parts

splash.definition: Planets scattered with no more than 2 per house, no more than 3 empty houses, no empty area >60°

bowl.definition: All planets within 180-190°, one side of opposition, ≤60° empty in occupied portion
bowl.interpretation: Self-contained in occupied houses, focuses on achieving in unoccupied area

bucket.definition: Bowl pattern with handle planet ≥30° from bowl planets

locomotive.definition: All planets within 240-250°, ≤60° empty, trine bridging empty area
locomotive.interpretation: Energetic, self-driving, focused on achieving purpose indicated by empty trine midpoint

seesaw.definition: Planets in two groups ≥60° apart, at least one opposition
seesaw.interpretation: Libra-like, concerned with relationships, balance, alternatives

bundle.interpretation: Self-contained, focused, limited perspective but deep resource development

fan.definition: All but 1-2 planets in bundle trine, singleton ≥60° from bundle opposing at least one planet
fan.interpretation: Uses handle planet as source of support/nourishment

splay.definition: Planets in 3 groups ≥60° apart, connected by grand trine in pure form

stellium.definition: Traditionally 4+ planets within 8° in same sign/house

grand_trine.definition: 3+ planets in same element, each trine the others

synthesis_worksheet.purpose: Systematic method to identify 15-20 important chart characteristics, reduce to 5-8 primary ones

C. Aspects & Other Chart Variables (aspect types, close aspects, minors, parallels, mutual receptions, nodes)
D. Preliminary Synthesis (strongest planets, signs, houses, aspects)

phase_1_delineation.purpose: Objective recording of all primary chart data without interpretation
data_collection_sequence: Calculate natal chart via reliable ephemeris or software
Record Ascendant and Midheaven signs and degrees
Record planetary positions in signs and houses
Identify major aspects between planets (conjunction, sextile, square, trine, opposition)
Note any planets in angular houses (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th)
Check for stelliums (3+ planets in one sign or house)
Document dispositor chains and final dispositors
